description: Fetch any public URL as a visitor in a chosen country, with a signed receipt of its origin.
name: dev.regionfetch/mcp

environmentVariables.description: Private key of a funded Base wallet. The server signs one fresh x402 authorization per tool call. Keep it in the host's env block; it is never a tool argument.
environmentVariables.name: REGION_FETCH_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Per-payment ceiling, for example "$0.10". Use "off" to disable the cap.
environmentVariables.name: REGION_FETCH_MAX_PAYMENT

environmentVariables.description: A single pre-made x402 authorization. Funds exactly one request, so this is for one-shot testing only; prefer the wallet key.
environmentVariables.name: REGION_FETCH_PAYMENT_SIGNATURE

title: Region Fetch
